delete.title: Delete all data?
delete.lead: Permanently deletes the database, the keys and the attachments from this phone. Backup copies outside the phone stay. Make a backup first — it is the only way back.

backup.lead: A backup is one encrypted file: the database, the keys and the attachments. Only your password opens it.
backup.what: Save it to iCloud Drive or another folder in Files. Moony has no access to it.
backup.unavailableHere: Backups work on iPhone only for now.
backup.restoreLead: Restore a backup from this phone, or transfer a profile from Moony on the computer: choose the backup file and, after the restore, unlock with the password that was in use when it was created.
backup.restoreConfirmDescription: The backup from {{date}} (Moony {{version}}, {{attachments}} attachments, {{size}}) replaces the data on this phone. Back up first if you want to keep the current data. Moony then locks; unlock it with the password that was in use when the backup was made.
backup.osBackupNote: The encrypted profile is also in the phone's own backup (iCloud or a computer); no one can open it without the password.

firstRun.privacyLead: Moony stores everything in an encrypted database on this phone. No cloud, no account with us.

encryption.title: AES-256 encryption
encryption.text: – only your password opens the database; photos and documents are encrypted inside it.

localOnly.title: No cloud
localOnly.text: – we send nothing anywhere; you save the backup to Files or iCloud Drive yourself.

marketData.title: Market data
marketData.text: – only the stock, currency and crypto rates you follow are downloaded (Yahoo Finance, CoinGecko, ECB). The app works offline too.

firstRun.recoveryLead: The only way to your data if you forget the password. Store it outside this phone: in a password manager, in Files, or on paper.
firstRun.recoveryFileNote: This key resets your Moony password. It works only together with the Moony data on this phone or a backup of it, so keep that backup too. Do not give this file to anyone.
firstRun.areasLead: Choose what you want to track in Moony. You can change this anytime in Settings.
firstRun.firstAccountLead: A name and a balance are enough. You can import a statement later.
firstRun.backupLead: This phone holds the only copy of your data. Save an encrypted backup to iCloud Drive or a folder you choose; Moony never sees it.

notifications.lead: Moony reminds you from this phone only, with no server. It plans the notifications each time you unlock.
